info.name: MSL — Subscription · Gemini AI · Past Questions
info.description:
# MSL API — Subscription, Gemini AI, Past Questions

Single Postman collection for the three surfaces used by desktop + web admin.

## Setup
1. Set `baseUrl` (no trailing slash), e.g. `http://localhost:4000`
2. Set `token` (JWT) and `deviceId` (must match user.device_id)
3. Optional: `timezone` (default Africa/Accra)

## Headers (authenticated requests)
| Header | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Authorization | Bearer {{token}} |
| x-device-id | {{deviceId}} |
| x-timezone | {{timezone}} |

## Access
- **Subscription (user)**: auth; AI routes also need active subscription
- **Gemini AI (user)**: auth + active course enrollment
- **Past Questions (user)**: auth + enrollment or active AI subscription
- **Admin folders**: ADMIN role

## SSE audio
Chat audio endpoints return `text/event-stream` with `text` (tokens), `audio` (WAV base64), `error`, `end`.
